items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive for Sunday vs DET as details finalize. Trade expected after Sunday games; Houston among teams in mix.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; expects much better role this week despite ankle maintenance, not on final IR. Tough projection spot given prior usage criticism.

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-risk stack long-term: knee issue, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, boomer coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman). Frustration over low second-half targets noted.
items.why: Sore knee (DNP), shoulder history, coaching/QB uncertainty compounding
items.implication: Monitor closely; short-term playable but ROS caution

Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5 (pushing 'Brown Gobbler' nickname); workload + Bengals injury context + soft matchup.
